audit.why: 52.36% over 2859 games, FAV at 7.5/10 with a 6/10 carry threat. Karma is a poke-and-utility lane that Mundo out-regenerates; the difficulty comes from discipline, not from lethality. The existing framing is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two rows disagreed with themselves. Level 6: win[4] and phases[4].side said Karma at 3/10, while phases[4].why on the same row says 'the lane flips to walk at him the moment you hit 6', whys[4] says 'it's even-ish', spikes[1] says your 6 is a real all-in spike, and the packet says Skill. 2+ items: both layers said Dr. Mundo, while whys[6] says 'it's skill-dependent' and the packet says Skill.
audit.why: Karma's ultimate is not a level-6 event at all — Mantra is available from level 1 and needs no skill point, so neither champion gets a new button at 6. Mundo gains a real ultimate, she gains nothing, but her shield and Mantra-Q still blunt the all-in: that is an even stage, not a Karma stage.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Skill (5/10) and 2+ items -> Skill (5/10) as one atomic group, with phases[4].why and phases[6].why rewritten to stop claiming a flip that the other three fields deny.
sources: enemyKit R text ('Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point')

audit.whatIsWrong: The focus ability carried no cooldown, no range, and no statement of the one interaction that decides it: Mundo's passive resists the first immobilizing effect, so Focused Resolve's root is absorbed and drops a healing cannister. Mantra's cooldown was described only as 'on cooldown between uses' when it is 40/38/36/34 and reduced by Gathering Fire every time one of her damaging abilities lands — which is what actually makes her poke pattern predictable.
audit.why: 'Her root gets eaten once, and every spell she lands shortens her Mantra' turns two vague warnings into a countable window.
audit.corrected: 12s / 675 range, the passive-eats-the-root interaction, and Mantra's 40s reduced-by-damage cooldown now appear in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, spikes[0] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] reads 'Buy grievous early so her shields don't outheal your damage'.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds reduces healing, not shielding — it does nothing to Inspire. The real anti-heal target is Mantra-W, which heals Karma while it extends the root.
audit.corrected: Pointed at Mantra-W's heal instead of at her shield.
sources: enemyKit W text (Mantra Bonus heals herself)

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma is referred to as 'he/him/his' throughout — report[0], tldr, tradeBad, breakdown.mid, dontsFull[0].d and others.
audit.corrected: Fixed in report[0].t and breakdown.mid, where the edit also carried real content; the rest are listed in notes.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage makes you nearly unkillable in long fights. The lane flips from 'survive' to 'walk at him' the moment you hit 6.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage arrives, but Mantra has been hers since level 1 — shield plus Mantra-Q blunt the all-in. Commit on her Mantra cooldown.

edits.before: You're a raid boss in side lanes and a front line in fights. The only losing move is fighting burst windows without R.
edits.after: You're a raid boss in the side lane, but her shields and speed still swing teamfights. Win the sidelane; don't expect a free 5v5.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (12s, 675 range): her root tether — walk out of range to break it, and your passive eats the root once. - Mantra (40s at rank 1, cut short by every damaging spell she lands). - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, not on waves.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — Cleaver-slow + run him down.
edits.after: Focused Resolve is 12s at 675 range — break the tether by walking out, and your passive absorbs the root once. Then run her down.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her 12s root tether — break it by leaving the 675 range, or let your passive eat it.

edits.before: Buy grievous early so her shields don't outheal your damage
edits.after: Buy Grievous Wounds for her Mantra-W heal, not for her shield

edits.before: Once Q Infected Bonesaw is up you shove and sustain through her Q Inner Flame poke; her mantra empowerment is on cooldown between uses, so you find windows to walk up and cleaver her.
edits.after: Once Q Infected Bonesaw is up you shove and sustain through her Q Inner Flame poke; Mantra is 40s at rank 1 and only her landed spells cut it, so every spell she misses is your window to walk up.

edits.before: Heartsteel/Sunfire plus grievous shrugs off her Mantra-Q burst; you walk through the RQ root-adjacent poke and E Blunt Force Trauma her down.
edits.after: Heartsteel shrugs off her Mantra-Q burst; walk through the poke, let your passive eat the Focused Resolve root, then E Blunt Force Trauma her down.

edits.before: He pokes your HP bar — Doran's Shield + passive sustain it back, then run him down with R.
edits.after: She pokes your HP bar — Doran's Shield and your passive regen it back, then run her down with R.

edits.before: From 6, Maximum Dosage turns extended fights unwinnable for Karma. Cleaver-slow, walk him down with E, and only disengage if his Focused Resolve burst window is up and your R is down.
edits.after: From 6, Maximum Dosage turns extended fights unwinnable for Karma. Cleaver-slow, walk her down with E, and disengage only when her Focused Resolve and Mantra are both up.
